name: epithet-miner
title: Epithet Miner: Homeric formulas from Project Gutenberg
description: Crawls public-domain Homer translations on Project Gutenberg and mines the noun-epithet formulas the oral poets improvised with ("aegis-bearing Zeus", "laughter-loving Aphrodite"), each tagged with its beat count from the CMU Pronouncing Dictionary, themes, emotions, source and frequency.
